propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable ticket-event history in the tickets-store git repository must be reclaimed through `git fast-export --no-data | filter | git fast-import` to bring the filtered pack under the 131072 KiB CI gate limit that is causing stale-base changes to fail verification.

Prerequisite ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a must be executed first in a coordinated quiet-window operation to repair diagnostics and achieve zero-repairable-diagnostic status with exactly four intentional STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED records before history rewrite begins.

The history rewrite must preserve exact tree, commit count, and merge-commit count equivalence, remove all `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/` residual commits, keep the published clone under 150 MB, and maintain byte-identical `(event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered)` multisets across the rewrite.

All writers must be paused, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, and operator confirmation recorded before any tracker convergence, backup creation, pin removal, rewrite execution, or repository publication can proceed.

The deterministic first post-rewrite write must be the re-pin review-bot LLM-Review vote with `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off` to prevent opportunistic enrichment drain, produce exactly the canonical four-commit sequence (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, code-review-to-work link, reciprocal work-to-code-review link), and add less than 1 MB to size-pack.

Rollback must restore from the retained off-repo bundle using exact `--force-with-lease` with operator confirmation, restore the prior `identity.enforce_since` boundary through Gerrit, and require identity-report equivalence before writers are re-enabled.
